admission_conditions: Sibling clause symmetric difference decomposes the active variable set into components of fixed size b<=5.
Every cross-component target clause touches exactly two recovered components.
After exact local signed-permutation filtering, each component has at most two valid local transport candidates in the tested direction.
All candidate compatibility and final global transport checks are exact; otherwise return NO_RULE_APPLICABLE.
algorithm: Recover blocks as connected components of the variable graph of A triangle B.
Enumerate at most b!*2^b signed maps inside every block and keep exact local transports.
For every interacting block pair, compute the exact allowed candidate-pair relation by replaying all cross-component target clauses against the source CNF.
Because each domain has size at most 2, encode every forbidden candidate pair (a,b) as one 2-CNF clause: (X_i != a) OR (X_j != b). One-candidate blocks become unit constraints.
Solve the resulting 2-SAT instance by implication-SCC in polynomial time, with no restriction on interaction-graph treewidth.
Assemble the selected block maps, globally verify the transport, and safe-delete only after independent maxdef/terminal/replay checks.

complexity.compatibility: at most 4 candidate pairs per interacting block pair
complexity.global_solver: linear-time 2-SAT in the compatibility instance after construction
complexity.overall: polynomial in encoded sibling size for fixed b

next_exact_frontier: Force at least three genuinely distinct local transport states per recovered block with connector constraints not reducible to 2-SAT, or make symmetric-difference components/cross-component arity unbounded, while retaining maxdef-criticality, R44BC escape, and no independent polynomial terminal.
